locked_at: 2026-10-22, before any CQ500 outcome was computed (only 9 scans processed, no labels joined)
reference: Majority (>=2 of 3 readers) per label in reads.csv
model: Frozen BHSD-trained v2 (no post-mask), no CQ500 tuning
primary_ich_rule: ICH positive if predicted volume >= 1.0 mL; AUC uses predicted volume as score
subtype: Binary model; per-subtype AUC of total predicted volume reported as descriptive only; subtype localization = fraction of BHX boxes containing >=1 predicted voxel on the matched SOPInstanceUID slice
laterality: Unilateral reader-majority side cases; predicted side from sign of mean voxel offset to ideal midline; axis0 increasing = DICOM column direction = patient left for standard orientation
midline_shift: Detection of reader MidlineShift by exploratory CSF-centroid offset (max abs, mm); AUC only; no mm accuracy claimed
mass_effect: AUC of predicted volume and of CSF offset for reader MassEffect
fracture: Scan-level reader Fracture (any) and CalvarialFracture; 5-fold stratified CV (seed 20261022) 2D slice CNN with max-over-slices pooling on bone images 128x128; AUC, sensitivity/specificity at Youden threshold chosen inside training folds
qc: Scans with p01 > -500 HU flagged and reported separately
